title: Refract theme file
description: A custom Refract theme: a built-in preset (base) plus colour overrides. Any token the file leaves out falls back to base.

$schema.description: Where this schema lives; editors use it for autocomplete and validation.

name.description: Shown in the theme list. 1 to 40 letters, digits, spaces, dashes, dots or brackets, with no leading or trailing space.

base.description: The built-in theme this file starts from; tokens the file omits take its values.

tokens.description: Colour overrides keyed by token name, without the leading "--". Leave out any token you do not want to change.

accent.description: Semantic role token. Highlight fill for hovered or selected neutral surfaces such as menu items.

accent-foreground.description: Semantic role token. Text and icons drawn on the accent fill.

accent-text.description: Semantic role token. Accent colour used for text and links on the page background.

active-indicator.description: Component token. Fill of the marker that shows the active item, for example the selected tab bar.

active-indicator-foreground.description: Component token. Text and icons drawn on the active-item indicator.

agent-message.description: Component token. Text colour of agent replies in the chat transcript.

agent-spinner-core.description: Component token. Centre colour of the agent activity spinner.

alert-caution.description: Component token. Accent colour of Caution callouts in rendered markdown.

alert-important.description: Component token. Accent colour of Important callouts in rendered markdown.

alert-note.description: Component token. Accent colour of Note callouts in rendered markdown.

alert-tip.description: Component token. Accent colour of Tip callouts in rendered markdown.

alert-warning.description: Component token. Accent colour of Warning callouts in rendered markdown.

approval-card-bg.description: Component token. Background of the approval card shown when an agent asks permission.

approval-card-border.description: Component token. Border of the approval card.

approval-card-fg.description: Component token. Text colour of the approval card.

background.description: Semantic role token. Main app background behind every pane.

border.description: Semantic role token. Default border and outline colour.

border-strong.description: Semantic role token. Stronger border for edges that must stay clearly visible.

button-destructive-bg.description: Component token. Fill of destructive buttons.

button-destructive-fg.description: Component token. Text and icons on destructive buttons.

button-destructive-hover-bg.description: Component token. Fill of destructive buttons while hovered.

button-outline-bg.description: Component token. Fill of outline buttons.

button-outline-border.description: Component token. Border of outline buttons.

button-outline-fg.description: Component token. Text and icons on outline buttons.

button-outline-hover-bg.description: Component token. Fill of outline buttons while hovered.

button-secondary-bg.description: Component token. Fill of secondary buttons.

button-secondary-fg.description: Component token. Text and icons on secondary buttons.

button-secondary-hover-bg.description: Component token. Fill of secondary buttons while hovered.

card.description: Semantic role token. Background of cards and raised panels.

card-foreground.description: Semantic role token. Text colour on cards and raised panels.

chart-1.description: Semantic role token. Chart series colour 1 of 5.

chart-2.description: Semantic role token. Chart series colour 2 of 5.

chart-3.description: Semantic role token. Chart series colour 3 of 5.

chart-4.description: Semantic role token. Chart series colour 4 of 5.

chart-5.description: Semantic role token. Chart series colour 5 of 5.

chat-card-bg.description: Component token. Background of cards inside the chat transcript.

chat-code-bg.description: Component token. Background of inline code in chat messages.

chat-code-fg.description: Component token. Text colour of inline code in chat messages.

chat-foreground.description: Component token. Default text colour of the chat transcript.

chat-user-bubble-bg.description: Component token. Background of your own message bubbles.

chat-user-bubble-border.description: Component token. Border of your own message bubbles.

chat-user-bubble-fg.description: Component token. Text colour of your own message bubbles.

code-block-bg.description: Component token. Background of fenced code blocks.

code-block-fg.description: Component token. Default text colour in fenced code blocks; overriding it or any syntax-* token switches code highlighting to the css-variables theme, so set them together.

command-pill-bg.description: Component token. Background of command pills in the message box.

command-pill-fg.description: Component token. Text colour of command pills.

composer-background.description: Component token. Background of the message box.

composer-border.description: Component token. Border of the message box.

composer-control-border.description: Component token. Border of the small controls in the message box toolbar.

composer-control-fg.description: Component token. Text and icons of the message box toolbar controls.

composer-control-hover-bg.description: Component token. Fill of a message box toolbar control while hovered.

composer-control-hover-fg.description: Component token. Text and icons of a message box toolbar control while hovered.

composer-control-open-bg.description: Component token. Fill of a message box toolbar control while its menu is open.

composer-focus.description: Component token. Border of the message box while it has focus.

composer-placeholder.description: Component token. Placeholder text in the empty message box.

composer-ring.description: Component token. Focus ring around the message box.

composer-selection-bg.description: Component token. Background of selected text in the message box.

composer-selection-fg.description: Component token. Colour of selected text in the message box.

destructive.description: Semantic role token. Colour for destructive actions and errors.

destructive-foreground.description: Semantic role token. Text and icons drawn on the destructive colour.

diff-removed.description: Component token. Marker and tint for removed lines in diffs.

divider.description: Semantic role token. Thin lines that separate regions, lists and sections.

field-border.description: Component token. Border of text fields and other form controls.

input.description: Semantic role token. Border and fill base for form inputs.

md-code-fg.description: Component token. Text colour of inline code in rendered markdown.

md-code-label.description: Component token. Language label above fenced code blocks in rendered markdown.

tooltip-fg.description: Component token. Text colour of tooltips.

colour.description: A hex colour (3, 4, 6 or 8 digits), transparent, or rgb(), hsl() or oklch() with numeric arguments.
